purpose: Decision-specific, risk-routed graph evidence with independent execution and admission states

graph_router_admission.failure_admission: SOURCE_FALLBACK when source readback is resolved; otherwise HOLD_THIS_SEAM

invariants: command success does not imply question admission
PASS plus NO_RELEVANCE remains PASS plus SOURCE_FALLBACK
PASS plus truncation remains PASS plus SOURCE_FALLBACK
G2 and G3 admission is derived from observed evidence and never trusts caller-supplied codegraph_admitted
G2 and G3 require PASS, RELEVANT, COMPLETE, and exact valid target SHA and tree bindings
an unresolved G3 authority chain is HOLD_THIS_SEAM
G0 and G1 tool unavailability does not globally hold unrelated seams
historical receipts with a mismatched target SHA are never admitted
source_readback: Graph evidence is navigation and scope discovery only; source, contract, and tests decide the engineering conclusion.
